objective: Determine whether the native scene gain depends on row-correct online state and screen conservative boundary routers that may recover recall without surrendering memory precision.

prior_exposure.claim_boundary: This is post-validation mechanism development. It may explain the accepted decoder and nominate a future candidate, but it cannot alter the accepted decoder or create a new untouched-validation claim.

causal_conditions.zero_state: Attach the frozen adapter, reset all online state, disable writes, and generate from the target read prompt.
causal_conditions.donor_state: Prime with a different TRAIN-derived development row, disable writes, and generate from the target read prompt.
causal_conditions.layer_permuted_correct_state: Prime the target row, export every online-state tensor, cyclically move each complete module-prefixed state bundle to the preceding wrapped layer, reload it, disable writes, and generate the target read prompt.
causal_conditions.correct_state_reference: Reuse the previously signed v9 target-row write-then-read generation; do not regenerate it.

donor_mapping.ordering: minimum absolute write-prompt token-count difference, then lowest source index

layer_permutation.mapping: target wrapped module at ordinal i receives the complete exported online-state bundle from ordinal (i+1) modulo 42

router_candidates.conditional_intersection: base intersect memory when memory is nonempty, otherwise base
router_candidates.memory_else_base: memory when memory is nonempty, otherwise base
router_candidates.memory_else_small_base_1: memory when nonempty; otherwise base only when base cardinality is at most 1
router_candidates.memory_else_small_base_2: memory when nonempty; otherwise base only when base cardinality is at most 2
router_candidates.memory_else_small_base_3: memory when nonempty; otherwise base only when base cardinality is at most 3
router_candidates.memory_plus_small_base_1: base union memory when base cardinality is at most 1, otherwise memory
router_candidates.memory_plus_small_base_2: base union memory when base cardinality is at most 2, otherwise memory
router_candidates.memory_plus_small_base_3: base union memory when base cardinality is at most 3, otherwise memory
router_candidates.memory_union_near_base_1: memory union base boundaries within distance 1 of any memory boundary
router_candidates.memory_union_near_base_2: memory union base boundaries within distance 2 of any memory boundary
router_candidates.snap_memory_to_base_1: replace each memory boundary by the closest base boundary within distance 1, tie toward the lower boundary
router_candidates.snap_memory_to_base_2: replace each memory boundary by the closest base boundary within distance 2, tie toward the lower boundary
router_candidates.intersection_else_memory: use the intersection when nonempty, otherwise memory

router_selection.ordering: micro-F1 descending, precision descending, recall descending, candidate name ascending

stopping_rule: Archive, commit, and push the causal and router outcomes whether pass or fail. Never read publisher-validation predictions, publisher test, or Hard32 for this study. A passing router is only a future replication candidate and does not replace the accepted decoder.
